records.industry: multi-site waste generators, waste passport compliance
records.physical_chain: process -> waste formation at each site -> identity of waste characteristics -> laboratory evidence -> waste passport -> changed physical or formal address -> renewal
confirmed_facts: No blanket reissuance of existing passports solely due to new Order 286 effective 2026-09-01.
Reissuance of FKKO passport within 30 calendar days after triggers in points 9-10, including formal changes of waste-generation address.
One passport covering multiple sites is possible only for stated III-IV-class end-of-use goods/packaging wastes and/or MSW subject to paragraph 6 evidence and classification criteria.
One-site test report can support several sites if documented process uniformity and classification identity at all sites; ministry interpretation is not an independent binding legal norm.
records.risk: Outdated address or unsupported multi-site passport creates documentary noncompliance
records.red_flag: One generic passport across multiple facilities with distinct processes, no site identity proof or formal address changed more than 30 days ago
diagnostic_questions: Есть ли изменение адресов мест образования отходов, включая формальное переименование улиц или адресных реквизитов, и когда оно произошло?
Какие паспорта объединяют несколько площадок, соответствуют ли отходы узкой категории пункта 6 Порядка №286?
Чем подтверждены идентичность отходов и единообразие процессов по всем адресам, включая протоколы и технические документы?
mirlex_checks: Compare passports with current FIAS address, facility list and waste formation locations
Verify 30-calendar-day renewal triggers under points 9-10 of Order 286
Test multi-site passport applicability only under point 6, do not infer universality
Separate letter interpretation from binding regulatory text
records.assistant: ECO_EXPERT_ONLY; no automatic ROP expert application

hypotheses.text: Multi-site businesses often treat one waste passport as universally applicable across sites, without paragraph 6 classification test.

records.legal_validity_gate: RESEARCH_ONLY until applicability and live integration verified
